import json,re
source=open('lean/Spec/Lexicon.lean').read()
block=source.split('def addedCommandNames : Version → List String\\n',1)[1].split('\\ndef commandNames',1)[0]
names=re.findall(r'\"(["'^"'"\\n]*)\"',block)
ps={p['id']:p for p in map(json.loads,open('passages.jsonl'))}
rule=ps['2.7-p109-07']['text']
standard=re.findall(r'\\( ([a-z][a-z-]*)',rule)
print(json.dumps({'lean_command_names':len(names),'passage_command_names':len(standard),'missing_from_lean':sorted(set(standard)-set(names)),'extra_in_lean':sorted(set(names)-set(standard))},indent=2))
print('All 16 referenced declarations located:')
for i in json.load(open('items.json')):
 name=i['declaration'].removeprefix('Spec.Lexicon.').removeprefix('Spec.Grammar.Tree.')
 path='lean/Spec/Grammar/Syntax.lean' if i['declaration'].startswith('Spec.Grammar.Tree.') else 'lean/Spec/Lexicon.lean'
 lines=open(path).read().splitlines()
 found=[j for j,l in enumerate(lines,1) if re.match(r'def '+re.escape(name)+r'(?:\\s|\\s*\\()',l)]
 print(i['item'],path,found)
PY"
